latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v2.11.0 -->

## What's Changed

## Key Features

### General:
- No longer mount HAMi-core for whole-GPU allocations; metrics are exported by NVML directly (#3112)
- Flexible-MIG improvements: CDI for dynamic MIG devices (#3070), MIG placement scoring with a backtracking fallback (#2855), and a per-pod MIG profile preference (#3014)
- Real-usage monitoring for Flexible-MIG workloads (#3270)
- Cluster Autoscaler: the extender no longer blocks scale-up for pods without HAMi resources (#2838)

### Remote CUDA:
- Run vLLM on remote GPUs served by Lupine (#3004, #3013)

### Schedule:
- NUMA refit for device allocations (#2729, #2731)
- Preferred nodeAffinity in node scoring (#3298)
- GPU accounting for native sidecar containers (#2723)

### Devices:
- Full AMD support
- Ascend 950 support (#3316)
- libvnpu performance optimization

PodGroup support, the mutex policy, policy combinations, CPU/GPU NUMA alignment and Flexible-MIG itself were introduced in [v2.10.0](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/releases/tag/v2.10.0).



### ✨ Features Details
* ci: allow manual dispatch of the Trivy image scan by @moezdil in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2768
* fix(monitor): replace MustNewConstMetric with safe helper and track InitContainers by @devGPP23 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2716
* feat(scheduler): account native sidecar container GPU resources by @maishivamhoo123 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2723
* Add nil node checks to PatchNodeAnnotations and RemoveNodeAnnotation by @KunwarSidhu47 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2792
* feat: add groundwork for NUMA-aware device refit by @saiyam1814 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2729
* feat: add scheduler NUMA refit for device allocations by @saiyam1814 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2731
* ci: run CodeQL on every pull request by @moezdil in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2816
* test(util): add unit tests for GetNode() function by @Kevindua26 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2798
* [kind/bug] Restore model-aware scheduling for Cambricon MLU devices by @asadjan4611 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2780
* [Feature] Add Prometheus metrics for scheduler leader and cache sync state by @KunwarSidhu47 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2758
* Feat/scheduler poddisruptionbudget by @im-Toqeer-506 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2773
* feat: add host PID broker server and device plugin integration by @iemAnshuman in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2417
* test(device): add unit tests for ReplaceUsage and GetResourceQuota by @KunwarSidhu47 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2825
* feat(e2e): add MIG E2E targets and fix GPU preflight fail-fast by @haitwang-cloud in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2742
* [Feature] Expose Hardware Health and Error Metrics in vGPUmonitor (Fixes #2717) by @Gurkaran18 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2732
* feat(device plugin): add auto detecting nvidiaDriverRoot by @FouoF in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2848
* test(scheduler): verify NUMA refit PATCH timeout releases allocLock by @asadjan4611 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2869
* webhook: validate device-scoring-weights at admission by @asadjan4611 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2827
* feat(nvidia): score MIG placements and add backtracking fallback. by @maishivamhoo123 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2855
* test(scheduler): add Go benchmarks for the Filter scoring path by @im-Toqeer-506 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2907
* feat(dashboard): compare allocated and host GPU memory by @Utkarsh56016 in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2922
* Add template to vNPU-mode by @archlitchi in https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/pull/2970
* feat(helm): add OpenSh

**Kubernetes GPU virtualization and heterogeneous accelerator scheduling for AI infrastructure.** [![CNCF Incubating](https://img.shields.io/badge/CNCF-Incubating-0086FF?logo=cncf&logoColor=white)](https://www.cncf.io/projects/hami/) [![Releases](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Project-HAMi/HAMi)](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/releases/latest) [![build status](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/actions/workflows/ci.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/actions/workflows/ci.yaml) [![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/Project-HAMi/HAMi/branch/master/graph/badge.svg?token=ROM8CMPXZ6)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/Project-HAMi/HAMi) [![docker pulls](https://img.shields.io/docker/pulls/projecthami/hami.svg)](https://hub.docker.com/r/projecthami/hami) [![LICENSE](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Project-HAMi/HAMi.svg)](/LICENSE)
[![OpenSSF Best Practices](https://www.bestpractices.dev/projects/9416/badge)](https://www.bestpractices.dev/en/projects/9416) [![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.scorecard.dev/projects/github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/badge)](https://scorecard.dev/viewer/?uri=github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi) [![FOSSA Status](https://app.fossa.com/api/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2FProject-HAMi%2FHAMi.svg?type=shield)](https://app.fossa.com/projects/git%2Bgithub.com%2FProject-HAMi%2FHAMi?ref=badge_shield) [![slack](https://img.shields.io/badge/Slack-4A154B?style=for-the-badge&logo=slack&logoColor=white)](https://cloud-native.slack.com/archives/C07T10BU4R2) [![discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.com/invite/Amhy7XmbNq) [![website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-1F883D?style=for-the-badge&logo=readthedocs&logoColor=white)](https://project-hami.io) English version | [中文版](README_cn.md) | [日本語版](README_ja.md)
HAMi stands for **Heterogeneous AI Computing Virtualization Middleware**. Formerly known as `k8s-vGPU-scheduler`, HAMi helps platform teams share expensive GPUs and other AI accelerators across Kubernetes workloads, isolate device memory and compute, and schedule pods with device-aware policies without changing application code. HAMi is a [CNCF Incubating](https://www.cncf.io/projects/hami/) and [CNCF Landscape](https://landscape.cncf.io/?item=orchestration-management--scheduling-orchestration--hami) project. It is also listed in the [CNAI Landscape](https://landscape.cncf.io/?group=cnai&item=cnai--general-orchestration--hami). ## Documentation | Get started | Configure and integrate | Observe and maintain | | --- | --- | --- | | [Architecture](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/core-concepts/architecture) | [Configuration and operations](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/configure) | [Device allocation metrics](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/monitoring/device-allocation) | | [GPU virtualization](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/core-concepts/gpu-virtualization) | [NVIDIA scheduling policies](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/nvidia-device/scheduling-policy) | [Device usage metrics](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/monitoring/real-time-device-usage) | | [Supported devices and vendor guides](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/device-supported) | [NVIDIA dynamic MIG](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/nvidia-device/dynamic-mig-support) | [Grafana dashboards](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/monitoring/grafana-dashboard) | | [Prerequisites](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/installation/prerequisites) | [Volcano integration](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/installation/how-to-use-volcano-vgpu) | [WebUI](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/hami-webui-user-guide) | | [Install and run a first workload](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/get-started/deploy-with-helm) | [Kueue integration](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/kueue/how-to-use-kueue) | [Upgrade and migrate values](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/installation/upgrade) | | [Benchmarks](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/userguide/benchmark) | | [Troubleshooting](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/troubleshooting) | | | | [Uninstall](https://project-hami.io/docs/next/installation/uninstall) | ## Repository resources - [Chart values reference](charts/hami/README.md) - [Workload examples](examples/) - [Agent skills](skill/) - [HAMi-WebUI repository](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi-WebUI) ## Roadmap, Governance, and Contributing Planned work for each release is tracked in the [roadmap issues](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/HAMi/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Akind%2Ffeature%20in%3Atitle%20roadmap%20sort%3Acreated-desc). HAMi is governed by [maintainers](./MAINTAINERS.md) and [contributors](./AUTHORS.md). Governance is described in the [HAMi community repository](https://github.com/Project-HAMi/community/blob/main/governance.md).
